actions.content:
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORKER=(ROOT/'tools/mirror_sync/mirror_sync_worker.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
LAUNCHER=(ROOT/'tools/mirror_sync/mirror_sync_supervisor_entrypoint.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

def test_queue_runs_before_mirror_cycle():
    loop=WORKER.split('while [ \"$RUNNING\" -eq 1 ]; do',1)[-1] if 'while [ \"$RUNNING\" -eq 1 ]; do' in WORKER else WORKER.split('while [ "$RUNNING" -eq 1 ]; do',1)[-1]
    assert loop.index('receive_universal_jobs') < loop.index('run_cycle')
    assert loop.index('dispatch_universal_jobs') < loop.index('run_cycle')
    assert loop.index('publish_universal_results') < loop.index('run_cycle')

def test_worker_external_steps_have_timeout():
    assert 'MIRROR_SYNC_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS' in WORKER
    assert WORKER.count('timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10') >= 4

def test_launcher_cannot_block_forever():
    assert 'MIRROR_LAUNCHER_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS' in LAUNCHER
    assert LAUNCHER.count('timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10') >= 3
